Send a file of the agent environment to the chat on the user's phone, with an
optional caption. The file must be inside the environment and at most 200 MiB.

Usage:
  adbuddy send <file> [--caption "…"] [flags]

Flags:
      --caption string   text that goes with the file in the chat (at most 64 KiB)
  -h, --help             help for send

Global Flags:
      --json   machine-readable JSON output, for the commands that support it
